name: West Coast
description: A pure tone made richer by frequency modulation and wavefolding, then struck through a low-pass gate that darkens as it fades: woody plucks, soft mallets and slowly folding drones.

params.name: Fold
params.description: How hard the tone is driven into the wavefolder. At zero it is a pure sine; turning it up folds the wave over itself again and again, and overtones bloom on top of the note.

params.name: Symmetry
params.description: Pushes the wave off centre before it is folded, so the two halves fold differently. That adds the even overtones: hollow and woody at zero, fuller and more reedy as it rises.

params.name: FM
params.description: How far a second oscillator bends the pitch of the tone at audio rate. A little adds a metallic edge; a lot makes it clang and growl.

params.name: Ratio
params.description: Pitch of the modulating oscillator against the note, which decides where FM puts its overtones. 1:1, 2:1, 3:1 and 5:1 stay in tune with the note, 1:2 adds the octave below, 3:2 is hollow and drum-like, and 7:2 clangs like a bell. Applies from the next note.

params.name: Timbre Env
params.description: How much each strike also pushes Fold up, so a note starts rich and mellows as it rings.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long the gate takes to open. At its shortest the note is struck like a drum or a plucked string; longer settings swell in.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long the gate takes to close after a strike or a released key. The sound falls quickly at first and then lingers, growing duller as it fades.

params.name: Sustain
params.description: How far the gate stays open while a key is held. At zero every note is a pluck that dies away on its own; at full it holds like an organ.

params.name: Colour
params.description: How far the gate opens. Low is dark and soft, a thump with little overtone; high lets the whole folded tone through, bright and open.

params.name: Chance
params.description: How much each new note differs from the last in brightness, edge, length and place between the speakers, as if a random voltage were patched in. At zero every note is the same.

params.name: Drift
params.description: How far each voice slowly wanders in pitch and in timbre while it sounds, which keeps held notes and drones alive.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many notes stack up.
